auto.name: The Dawn Beyond the Everwinter
auto.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive shots with a bow.

Charged Attack
Performs a more precise Aimed Shot with increased DMG.
While aiming, Cryo will accumulate on the arrowhead. A fully charged Cryo arrow will deal Cryo DMG.

Plunging Attack
Fires off a shower of arrows in mid-air before falling and striking the ground, hitting opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skill.name: Polestar's Divine Judgment
skill.description:
Reveals the true nature of [[Transcendence|Transcendence and Blessings]], dealing AoE Cryo DMG and unleashing her power in different ways depending on whether the skill is tapped or held.

**Tap**
Gains the Blessing of **Love** and throws the **Palestar Crown**, an heirloom of the imperial court.
The **Palestar Crown** follows the active character and deals 2 instances of AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents every 2s.
[[Radiance: Stellar Glimmer|@11500004]]: The second instance of DMG dealt by each **Palestar Crown** attack becomes AoE Cryo DMG that is considered DMG from the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction.

**Hold**
Gains the Blessing of **Honor** and demonstrates the consummate skill at arms passed down by the imperial court.
In this mode, Anastasya's Normal Attacks are replaced by a sequence of up to 5 attacks with the **Blessed Spear: Dolgomernoye**, dealing AoE Cryo DMG that cannot be overridden by other Elemental Infusions. She cannot perform Charged Attacks in this mode.
[[Radiance: Stellar Glimmer|@11500004]]: The final instance of DMG from each Normal Attack performed with the **Blessed Spear** becomes AoE Cryo DMG that is considered DMG from the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction.

burst.name: To the New World
burst.description:
Anastasya's current [[Blessing|Transcendence and Blessings]] determines which Elemental Burst she can use and how she wields the power of [[Sealing]].

**To the New World**
Can be used while Anastasya holds the Blessing of **Love**. Deals AoE Cryo DMG and [[freezes|Freeze]] the Palestar Crown's duration.
During this time, all nearby party members deal increased Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG, and the Palestar Crown deals 1 additional instance of AoE Cryo DMG that is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG with each attack. Anastasya also [[Seals|Sealing]] herself when she switches off-field during this time. When her **Sealed** state ends, she can use the special unsealing Elemental Skill [[Palestar Edict: Triumph]].

**The Evernight Yields to Dawn**
Can be used while Anastasya holds the Blessing of **Honor**. Unleashes the power of the **Blessed Spear**, dealing AoE Cryo DMG considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG, and [[freezes|Freeze]] the Blessing's duration.
Anastasya also [[Seals|Sealing]] up to 3 other party members. When the **Sealed** state ends, Anastasya can use the special unsealing Elemental Skill [[Palestar Edict: Doom]].

[[Radiance: Stellar Glimmer|@11500004]]: All Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG described above is instead dealt as AoE Cryo DMG that is considered DMG from the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction.

passive1.name: The Radiant Reign of Night
passive1.description:
All party members gain **Accolades** for 20s after Anastasya uses her Elemental Skill **Polestar's Divine Judgment**, increasing their CRIT DMG by 12%.
When a party member is [[Sealed|Sealing]], their **Accolades** are temporarily divided equally among party members who are not [[Sealed|Sealing]] until 8s after that character's Sealed state ends.

passive2.name: Lament for the Lost

passive3.name: Stellar Jubilee: Immaculate Return
passive3.description:
Anastasya will be in the **Radiance: Stellar-Conduct** state while within a [[Polestar Field|@11330003]], and in the **Radiance: Stellar Swirl** state for 8s after a party member triggers a Stellar Swirl reaction nearby.
Party members trigger Stellar-Conduct/Stellar Swirl reactions instead of Superconduct/Cryo Swirl reactions, respectively. Anastasya also increases party members' Stellar-Conduct and Stellar Swirl base DMG by 0.7% for every 100 ATK she has, up to a maximum increase of 14%.

otherPassives.name: The Falling Snow's Favor
otherPassives.description:
Party members gradually restore HP while out of combat in Snezhnaya (excluding Nod-Krai).
Additionally, while Anastasya is in the party, the Eye of Graeae does not lose energy, and its energy is immediately replenished to 30% if it is below 30%.
These effects do not apply in Domains, Trounce Domains, or the Spiral Abyss.

constellations.name: To Years Past, To Hearts Still Alight
constellations.description:
The Ascension Passive **The Radiant Reign of Night** is enhanced: **Accolades** also increase the ATK of Cryo characters by 15% and the Elemental Mastery of characters of other Elemental Types by 60.
Additionally, when a character is [[Sealed|Sealing]], the equal division of **Accolades** will not cause the sharing character's **Accolades** to be dispelled. When Anastasya is [[Sealed|Sealing]], the **Accolades** she grants to other characters will provide 300% of their original bonuses.

constellations.name: To Winter, All Who Taste Its Bite
constellations.description:
After Anastasya uses her Elemental Skill, **Polestar's Divine Judgment**, the following effects apply based on her current Blessing:
· **Love**: The CRIT DMG of Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG dealt by all party members is increased by 60% for 30s;
· **Honor**: Anastasya's Normal Attacks, Elemental Burst **The Evernight Yields to Dawn**, and special Unsealing Elemental Skill [[Palestar Edict: Doom]] deal 125% of their original DMG for 15s.

Additionally, Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is [[Elevated|@11190007]] by 5%.

constellations.name: To White Nights, Set Our Grief Afire
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of the Elemental Burst **To the New World** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Tyrants, Sing The Rebel's Choir
constellations.description: Enhances **Accolades**, increasing CRIT DMG, ATK, and Elemental Mastery bonuses to 130% of their original values.

constellations.name: March On, Till Rot's Last Ember Dies
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of **Polestar's Divine Judgment** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Look Up, a Dawn Unstained Shall Rise
constellations.description:
After Anastasya uses her Elemental Skill, **Polestar's Divine Judgment**, the following effects apply based on her current Blessing:
· **Love**: The next time another character is switched onto the field, an effect equivalent to [[Palestar Edict: Triumph]] is triggered, dealing 250% of its original DMG. Additionally, Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG dealt by all nearby party members is [[Elevated|@11190007]] by 10%;
· **Honor**: The next time the Elemental Skill is tapped, an effect equivalent to the third attack of [[Palestar Edict: Doom]] is triggered, dealing 200% of its original DMG. If the other party members are not [[Sealed|Sealing]], Anastasya is considered to possess the **Accolades** of all party members for this attack. Additionally, Stellar Glimmer Reaction DMG dealt by Anastasya is [[Elevated|@11190007]] by 20%.

The above effects last for 30s and can be triggered once every 15s. They are removed when other party members' [[Sealed|Sealing]] status ends.

glossary.name: Transcendence and Blessings
glossary.description:
When Anastasya uses her Elemental Skill **Polestar's Divine Judgment**, she unleashes her power in different ways and gains a different Blessing depending on whether the skill is tapped or held.
·**Tap**: Gains the Blessing of **Love**;
·**Hold**: Gains the Blessing of **Honor**.
Each Blessing allows Anastasya to use a different Elemental Burst and wield the power of **Sealing** differently.
Anastasya always holds the Blessing of **Love** when she does not hold the Blessing of **Honor**.

glossary.name: Sealing
glossary.description:
A special state applied to characters when Anastasya uses her Elemental Burst. Characters in the Sealed state cannot be switched in.
The initial Sealing duration matches the duration of the corresponding Elemental Burst. Its remaining duration can be reduced through specific means.
Anastasya's **Blessing** determines which Elemental Burst she uses and how she wields the power of Sealing:
·**Love**: Anastasya Seals herself when she switches off-field. Stellar Glimmer reaction DMG dealt by any nearby party member can reduce the remaining duration of her Sealed state. For a limited time after her Sealed state ends, switching Anastasya in triggers the special unsealing Elemental Skill **Palestar Edict: Triumph**;
·**Honor**: Anastasya Seals up to 3 other party members. Anastasya can reduce the remaining duration of Sealing by using Normal Attacks. For a limited time after a character's Sealed state ends, selecting that character for the first time triggers the special unsealing Elemental Skill **Palestar Edict: Doom** instead of switching them in.

glossary.name: Palestar Edict: Triumph
glossary.description:
A special Elemental Skill triggered by switching Anastasya in after her own Sealed state ends. Deals AoE Cryo DMG to nearby opponents. This DMG is considered Stellar-Conduct reaction DMG.
**Radiance: Stellar Glimmer**: The aforementioned DMG is instead dealt as AoE Cryo DMG that is considered DMG from the corresponding Stellar Glimmer reaction.

glossary.name: Freeze
glossary.description: A special mechanic. Pauses an effect's duration, preventing it from counting down until the effect that triggered the freeze ends.
